Jakub Novak  
📞 +91 98765 43210 | 📧 j.novak@cloudflow.saas | 📍 Bengaluru, India  

A seasoned QA engineer with 8 years of expertise in delivering robust test automation frameworks for SaaS platforms. Specializing in API testing, test strategy design, and performance optimization, I have consistently driven measurable improvements in quality and efficiency across cross-functional teams. My work at CloudFlow SaaS has focused on scaling test environments and integrating CI/CD pipelines to accelerate release cycles while minimizing post-deployment defects.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Senior QA Engineer - Test Automation Architect*  
**CloudFlow SaaS** (2022–Present)  
Led the design and implementation of automated test environments for 15+ cross-functional initiatives, reducing provisioning time by 50% through script-driven infrastructure provisioning. Spearheaded the integration of performance testing tools (k6) into CI/CD pipelines, identifying critical bottlenecks in distributed systems and improving system stability by 30%. Developed a centralized API testing framework using Python, which became the standard for new feature development and regression validation.  

*QA Architect*  
**NexaCloud** (2020–2022)  
Architected end-to-end test strategies for three flagship products, resulting in a 35% reduction in post-release defects. Introduced behavior-driven development (BDD) practices with Cucumber, aligning testing efforts with business requirements and reducing miscommunication between stakeholders. Automated 80% of regression test cases using Selenium and Playwright, enabling parallel execution across browsers and devices.  

*Test Automation Lead*  
**ApexDev SaaS** (2017–2020)  
Designed CI/CD integration pipelines that reduced manual intervention in testing by 60%, improving test coverage from 65% to 89%. Pioneered the use of JMeter for load testing, identifying scalability issues in real-time data processing modules and guiding architectural adjustments. Mentored junior engineers in test automation best practices, fostering a culture of proactive quality assurance.  

*QA Engineer*  
**TechNova Inc.** (2015–2017)  
Built regression test frameworks for 12+ microservices, reducing bug escape rate by 40% through continuous integration. Collaborated with DevOps teams to implement automated monitoring tools, ensuring test environments mirrored production configurations.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **API Testing**: Central to my identity; architected scalable testing frameworks for SaaS platforms, mentoring teams on RESTful API validation and mocking strategies.  
- **BDD/TDD**: Owned the adoption of Cucumber for behavior-driven development, aligning test cases with user stories and reducing requirement ambiguity by 45%.  
- **Performance Testing**: Led load testing initiatives using JMeter and k6, identifying and resolving latency issues in high-traffic scenarios.  
- **Selenium/Playwright**: Developed cross-browser test suites for web applications, ensuring compatibility across 10+ platforms and reducing manual testing hours by 70%.  
- **Test Automation**: Designed frameworks that integrated with CI/CD pipelines, reducing regression cycles from 3 weeks to 2 days.  
- **Test Strategy Design**: Defined long-term testing roadmaps for three SaaS products, aligning with business goals and technical debt reduction.  
- **Python**: Utilized for scripting test data generation and automating environment setup, streamlining workflows for QA teams.  
- **Java**: Occasionally leveraged for backend integration testing, ensuring compatibility between microservices.  

**Projects**  
- **CloudFlow SaaS Test Environment Optimization**: Redesigned provisioning workflows using Python scripts, cutting deployment time by 50% and reducing configuration errors.  
- **NexaCloud API Test Framework**: Built a modular Python-based framework for automated API validation, adopted across three product lines.  
- **ApexDev SaaS Performance Benchmarking**: Conducted stress tests with JMeter, identifying and resolving bottlenecks in real-time data processing.  
- **Cross-Team Test Automation Standardization**: Established reusable components for test scripts, reducing duplication and improving maintainability.
